Neither SKILL.md nor references/testing-django.md contains any test-first / write-the-test-before-the-code instruction (grepped the references chain for test ordering; testing-django.md is APITestCase/fixtures/factory recipes only). A track handed this skill under a test-first mandate gets an internally build-first methodology.
